items.name: Basel Committee (BCBS) AI/ML Guidance
items.description: Basel Committee model risk management and AI/ML guidance, referenced by section only: our own-language paraphrase; no BIS text is embedded

titles.text: Model risk principles applied to AI/ML

requirements.text: Model developers do not validate their own models: independent validation is required for all material models, aligning with Principle 12 of the SR 11-7 governance standard now carried forward by SR 26-2.
requirements.rationale: Independence is the governance constant; SR 26-2 ties quality to review rigour rather than separation alone.

controls.description: Route material models, including AI/ML models, through validation functionally independent of development.

requirements.text: The Committee's ongoing work on AI and machine learning in banking extends model governance, validation and risk management expectations to AI/ML techniques.
requirements.rationale: AI-specific guidance is evolving; firms are expected to absorb it into existing frameworks.

controls.description: Track BCBS AI/ML publications and map changes into the firm's model risk framework.
